reasoning: The payment was held due to an AM05 duplication flag, with two identical instructions received minutes apart. The client and beneficiary match several prior cases where the ERP system generated duplicate files, all resolved as CLIENT_ERP_DUPLICATE.
recommended_action: Contact the client to confirm whether the second instruction was intentional. If not, advise them to cancel the duplicate and ensure their ERP does not resend the same file. Release the first instruction if the client confirms it is the intended payment.
draft_message:
Dear Arcadia Foods,

Our system detected a duplicate payment instruction for USD 12,420.00 to Mekong Delta Seafood JSC (account ending ****8093) received at 06:13 and 06:46 SGT on 28 Sep 2026. The second instruction has been held pending your confirmation. Please advise if this was an accidental duplicate; if so, we will cancel the second instruction and proceed with the first.

Thank you,
Payments Operations
prevention_tip: Configure the ERP to flag and suppress duplicate payment files before submission.
